scope: origin-free drop consumers and conservative correctness routing only

contracts.moved_piece: a drop resolves to side-to-move plus dropped type without reading an origin square
contracts.speculative_prefetch: returns no key for every Crazyhouse move; exact post-transition prefetch remains in Position::do_move
contracts.see: disabled for all Crazyhouse moves until separately justified; returns pass
contracts.shuffling: orthodox from-square shuffling detection is disabled for Crazyhouse
contracts.move_picker: drops are scored and emitted without origin-square access
contracts.chess: orthodox moved-piece, speculative-key, SEE and move-picker paths remain selected

cases.policy: all Crazyhouse moves pass SEE pruning regardless of threshold
